svg.title: Fig. 84(c) — The evolute of y = x³ (R₀ = ∞)
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 84(c), page 90. Section: evolutes.

g.data-text: The axes and the cubic y = x³: a flex at O, where the curvature is zero (R0 = ∞).
The evolute (heavy): the flex corresponds to an asymptote of the evolute, here the y-axis; each half has a cusp and an arm crossing the axis.
